scripts._comment:gate:assets: Weighs what the *browser* downloads. `gate:bundle` weighs the Worker script, which is why the 3.26 MB login logo (audit P1) was invisible to CI: Cloudflare stores static assets separately, against no bundle limit. Needs a real ../frontend/dist, so CI runs it from the frontend job — see .github/workflows/ci.yml.
scripts._comment:seed:region7: Seed 0005 is generated from scripts/build-region7-seed.mjs, which holds the Region VII catalog as readable tables and resolves every cross-reference by natural key. `seed:region7` rewrites the SQL; `seed:region7:check` fails if the committed SQL no longer matches the data it came from, which is what stops a hand-edit to the .sql from being silently reverted by the next regeneration. CI runs the check.
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply CareerLinkAI_Staging --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply CareerLinkAI_Main --remote --env production
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:staff && npm run db:seed:catalog:region7 && npm run db:seed:ai-policy
scripts._comment:db:seed:catalog:region7: The catalog (seed 0005): the 22 Bohol campuses of `colleges.md`, and nothing else — seeds 0002 (the Manila demo fixture) and 0004 (the nationwide catalog) were DELETED because either one would have put non-Bohol institutions back, and a superseded catalog that still has a runner is a catalog somebody eventually runs. This one is a RESET, not an addition: it deletes every college, programme, canonical programme, career and mapping first, and that cascades to every student's stored recommendations. Those regenerate on demand (`POST /student/recommendations/regenerate`, audit C4) and nothing a student authored is touched. Generated from scripts/build-region7-seed.mjs — see `seed:region7`.
scripts._comment:verify:corpus: Read-only. Asks the database whether every active college, programme and career has a live, COMPLETED, embedded knowledge entry, whether any entry outlived its subject, and whether the passages carry their facts. The sync's own changed/retired/remaining counters cannot answer that — a dropped queue continuation leaves a partial corpus that reports success. Run it after any catalog seed.
scripts._comment:db:seed:catalog:region7:product: Guarded since 2026-09-22 (migrations 0040/0041 made /admin the source of truth for the catalog): prints what the reset would destroy and refuses unless you append -- --confirm-delete-admin-edits. See scripts/reset-catalog-remote.mjs.
scripts._comment:db:backup: Plan P3-5. Exports AND verifies: the dump's per-table row counts are compared against the live database's own COUNT(*), because `wrangler d1 export` exits 0 on an empty database and a mistargeted --env writes a perfect backup of nothing, every night, until the restore. Retention and the offsite copy are in BACKUP-AND-RECOVERY.md.
scripts._comment:db:restore: Takes --from/--into and refuses to guess either. For an in-place rollback inside 30 days use `wrangler d1 time-travel restore` instead — it needs no dump and leaves no window in which the data is absent.
scripts._comment:db:restore:drill: The rehearsal. Restores a backup into a throwaway local database, boots the real Worker against it, and asserts a student is served the recommendations the backup holds. Nothing it does can reach a deployed database.
